changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: NextGen NaCRRI TRICOT 2021
study.description: The National Crops Resources Research Institute (NaCRRI) under the “NextGen Cassava Breeding project” has been evaluating cassava clones along the breeding pipeline. The cassava clones are ready for late-stage evaluation by farmers. NextGen NaCRRI will be implementing the second phase of the TRICOT to generate end-users' preference data which will be combined with experimental data  for official variety release/ licensing. Data co-produced by the National Crops Resources Research Institute (NARO) and Cornell University. This is the second cycle (September 2021 to October 2022; Arua, Buikwe, Busia, Dokolo, Kibaale, Luwero, Serere and Tororo) described in Nanyonjo AR, Angudubo S, Iragaba P, Brown D, Nuwamanya E, Esuma W, Ozimati A, Wembabazi E, Kanaabi M, Muhumuza N, Bayiyana I, van Etten J, de Sousa K, Tufan H, Kawuki RS (2024) On-farm evaluation of cassava clones using the triadic comparison of technology options approach. Crop Sci. 64, https://doi.org/10.1002/csc2.21293. Code and data of the paper at https://github.com/EQUAL-Lab/NextGen_Cassava_tricot_Uganda
